test_name: System and Information Integrity - SI-7 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Partner-Gateway-186
Primary NIST family: System and Information Integrity (SI); evidence focus: SI-7.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: a signed artifact has valid provenance but its SBOM upload is one pipeline cycle late. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
